## Purpose and Entry Points
Piko is a Morphe patch bundle for modifying Android X/Twitter and Instagram APKM packages. It is not a standalone app: Morphe Manager or CLI loads the built bundle, selects compatible patches, rewrites a target APKM, and installs the resulting app. Build/module entry points are `settings.gradle.kts`, `build.gradle.kts`, and `patches/build.gradle.kts`; published patch metadata is `patches-bundle.json` and `patches-list.json`.

## Patch Authoring Layer
Kotlin patch definitions locate target-app bytecode/resources through fingerprints and inject hooks, code, or resources. Instagram and X are separate patch domains:
- `patches/src/main/kotlin/app/crimera/patches/instagram/misc/extension/SharedExtensionPatch.kt`
- `patches/src/main/kotlin/app/crimera/patches/twitter/misc/extension/ExtensionPatch.kt`
- `patches/src/main/kotlin/app/crimera/patches/twitter/ads/timelineEntryHook/TimelineEntryHookPatch.kt`

Feature patches commonly depend on foundational entity, settings, resource, or extension patches rather than directly communicating with one another.

## Runtime Extension Injection
The patch layer embeds and invokes Android Java extension code inside the patched target process. App initialization hooks establish this boundary; injected code then interacts with target UI/model classes and Android APIs.
- Instagram bootstrap: `patches/src/main/kotlin/app/crimera/patches/instagram/misc/extension/hooks/ApplicationInitHook.kt`
- Instagram runtime: `extensions/instagram/src/main/java/app/morphe/extension/instagram/patches/`
- X runtime: `extensions/twitter/src/main/java/app/morphe/extension/twitter/patches/`

This is the critical compatibility boundary: Kotlin patches target version-specific, often obfuscated app bytecode, while Java extensions execute against the patched app at runtime.

## Target-Specific Data and UI Hooks
Entity-generation patches expose otherwise internal Instagram/X objects to extension code; UI patches add settings, menus, buttons, timeline filtering, media actions, and privacy behavior. Examples:
- Instagram media/entity bridge: `patches/src/main/kotlin/app/crimera/patches/instagram/entity/mediadata/MediaDataEntity.kt`
- Instagram download runtime: `extensions/instagram/src/main/java/app/morphe/extension/instagram/patches/download/DownloadUtils.java`
- X tweet/entity bridge: `patches/src/main/kotlin/app/crimera/patches/twitter/entity/TweetEntityPatch.kt`
- X native download runtime: `extensions/twitter/src/main/java/app/morphe/extension/twitter/patches/nativeFeatures/downloader/NativeDownloader.java`

Typical flow: fingerprint target method → inject call/hook → extension receives target data → applies preferences/logic → alters UI, network-related behavior, or local media handling.

## Settings, Resources, and Persistence
Settings patches inject entry points/resources into target apps; extension activities/fragments render controls and persist choices. Shared preferences and backup/restore are runtime-local to the patched application.
- Instagram settings injection: `patches/src/main/kotlin/app/crimera/patches/instagram/misc/settings/SettingsPatch.kt`
- X settings runtime: `extensions/twitter/src/main/java/app/morphe/extension/twitter/settings/Settings.java`
- Local preference abstraction: `extensions/shared/library/src/main/java/app/morphe/extension/crimera/SharedPref.java`
- Localized injected resources: `patches/src/main/resources/addresources/values/twitter/strings.xml`

## Shared Library and Compile-Time Stubs
`extensions/shared/library` supplies reusable downloader, settings, crash, storage, and request functionality used by target extensions. Stub modules provide compile-time declarations for classes owned by Instagram/X/Material; they are compatibility scaffolding, not bundled replacements.
- Shared downloader: `extensions/shared/library/src/main/java/app/morphe/extension/crimera/downloader/MediaDownloader.java`
- HTTP abstraction: `extensions/shared/library/src/main/java/app/morphe/extension/shared/requests/Requester.java`
- X stubs: `extensions/twitter/stub/src/main/java/`
- Instagram stubs: `extensions/instagram/stub/src/main/java/`

## Build, Distribution, and External Dependencies
The project is Gradle-based Kotlin/Java Android patch code, consumed by the Morphe patching runtime. GitHub Actions builds/releases artifacts; Crowdin workflows synchronize translations. External operational dependencies are Morphe (patch application), original APKM inputs (typically ApkMirror), target-app backends, optional translation providers in the X extension, and Piko-Shim for newer X compatibility.
- Release automation: `.github/workflows/release.yml`
- Translation configuration: `crowdin.yml`
- Version mapping references: `docs/mappings/435.0.0.37.76.json`
